name: The New Frontier
desc:
Welcome to The New Frontier, the most intense winter survival game made around the colonization of northern Canada. This game offers a massive landscape with mountains, caves, and rivers! You can hunt to gather food and craft items or you can get into the trading of the 18th century! You decide your fate, but there will be obstacles!
